local_inspection_groups.entry_state: Company statements must be connected to event histories and financing terms rather than read as self-explanatory cash balances. This chapter asks how those choices change ownership, claims and the group boundary.

findings.judgment: The chapter states the bridge from funding terms to ownership and consolidation. It warns that the coupon-bearing convertible and later zero-coupon compound example are distinct contracts.

Contract and accounting layers are separated before the Apple debt case. The carrying amount reconciliation distinguishes principal, unamortized premium/fees and hedge fair-value adjustment; cash repayment is not inferred from carrying movement.

Commercial-paper net flows hide refinancing and intraperiod liquidity. The 60-day borrowing example ties interest, journals and cash while explicitly refusing to claim it reconstructs Apple's history.

Rate sensitivity, contract notionals, fair-value measures and VaR refer to different populations and cannot be summed as one rate exposure. The section hands off from financing claims to owner quantities.

The EPS denominator depends on shares outstanding over dated intervals, while cash/resource-changing events and splits affect weighting differently. The split example is staged before potential-share selection.

Attribution facts precede instrument testing. The convertible profile now states its original holder right, any-time pre-maturity exercise, functional-currency denomination, equity classification, share-only settlement, unchanged terms and absent inducement/extra derivative. The supplied coupon and effective-rate schedule identify its own cash obligations.

cold_reader_answers.why_not_carrying_value_for_cash: Carrying changes include noncash amortization, fees and hedge adjustments, while cash repayments and proceeds are dated flows.
cold_reader_answers.why_dated_share_count: A closing share count assigns earnings to shares that may not have existed for the full reporting period.
cold_reader_answers.what_is_the_original_right: The holder may elect share-only conversion at any time before stated maturity; the issue terms and classification are explicit synthetic premises.

four_ledgers.reader_comprehension: The progression moves from financing data to contract-specific funding, then to ownership and EPS quantities.
four_ledgers.mathematical_integrity: The displayed debt identities and dated EPS intervals are preserved; the new early-conversion source question is not answered by this segment.
four_ledgers.source_fidelity: Apple amounts remain issuer disclosures and are not treated as a complete borrowing history. Synthetic rates and contract facts remain assumptions.
four_ledgers.typography: The opening heading and tables are legible at normal resolution; no clipped text or detached qualifier was observed.

local_inspection_groups.exit_state: The reader has seen how financing cash and carrying amounts diverge, and why share counts need dated histories. The following pages compare potential-share series and explain their dilution order before actual conversion changes the share windows.

local_inspection_groups.entry_state: The reader has seen how financing cash and carrying amounts diverge, and why share counts need dated histories. The following pages compare potential-share series and explain their dilution order before actual conversion changes the share windows.

findings.judgment: Options, debt and preference shares have distinct increments. Sequential inclusion changes the continuing-EPS control; the worked numerical outputs and sign-change tests clarify that total profit cannot replace continuing operations.
The finite selector's exact ratio test and ordering proof are tied to fixed, additive effects and positive denominators. The prose marks dependency and mutual exclusivity as outside this rule.

The report preserves unresolved candidates and rejects missing inventory, overlap and known unsupported methods instead of silently dropping a series. The actual-conversion subsection distinguishes preconversion potential shares from post-conversion actual shares.

The new treatment is explicitly attributed to BDO practice interpretation, not literal early-exercise wording in IAS 32.AG32. The liability transfers at 9,200 without gain/loss or the remaining 400 interest; IFRIC 19's exclusion and IFRS 9's alternative are stated. Tax facts remain supplied assumptions.

The company-level case begins with a separate contract that converts at maturity, then follows issue classification, interest, settlement, tax, group earnings and cash consequences. Its maturity facts keep it distinct from the preceding early-conversion illustration.

The company EPS denominator distinguishes actual fourth-quarter shares from potential shares and links the join to source-bound journals. A different tax base creates an initial deferred-tax charge to equity; the formula identifies its synthetic assumptions and does not imply later tax earnings effects.

cold_reader_answers.what_amount_transfers: The liability's carrying value after the October coupon, 9,200; the original 800 conversion-equity component remains in equity.
cold_reader_answers.why_no_remaining_interest: Under the selected BDO interpretation, conversion date is treated as maturity for the original holder right, so remaining accretion to face is not accelerated.
cold_reader_answers.which_authority_is_express: IAS 32.AG32 says conversion at maturity; BDO section 4.5 supplies the practice interpretation for the pre-maturity exercise date.
cold_reader_answers.why_eps_windows_do_not_overlap: The potential-share interval ends when conversion occurs; actual issued shares enter the basic denominator from that date.

four_ledgers.reader_comprehension: The worked dilution rule supplies the bridge from hypothetical share changes to actual conversion and then to company-level EPS.
four_ledgers.mathematical_integrity: The exact arithmetic record checks the debt carrying amount, expense, tax inputs and 92-day windows. General dependent/nonadditive series selection remains outside the finite proof.
four_ledgers.source_fidelity: BDO's view is labeled as practice interpretation; the maturity text, competing extinguishment rule, IFRIC exclusion and tax-source limits remain visible.
four_ledgers.typography: Pages 183–188 were inspected at 110 dpi. The policy passage and next company case cross the page break cleanly and retain their conditions.

local_inspection_groups.exit_state: The synthetic early-conversion policy is narrow, selected and source-qualified. Its 9,200 transfer and EPS consequences are separated from the following maturity-conversion company contract; the next section carries the supplied tax bases into earnings.

local_inspection_groups.entry_state: The synthetic early-conversion policy is narrow, selected and source-qualified. Its 9,200 transfer and EPS consequences are separated from the following maturity-conversion company contract; the next section carries the supplied tax bases into earnings.

findings.judgment: The one-period maturity tax example distinguishes coupon cash from discount accretion and carries the supplied fiscal base through deferred-tax reversal. The formula is explicitly illustrative and does not generalize to other tax bases.

Consequential tax earnings are included in diluted EPS while the issue-date equity charge is excluded from the numerator. Equal diluted fractions across conversion and redemption worlds are correctly described as non-interchangeability, not identical economics.

Apple's reported share quantities narrow but do not identify a complete event history. The document introduces a signed time-weighted share equation and two admissible histories to show why dates and joint alternatives must be retained.

Repurchases, RSUs, withholding, compensation expense and cash flows are kept as different movements. The tables preserve reporting populations and state that arithmetic does not establish the award method.

The plan reserve, award terms and delivered shares are separated. A small withholding example makes reserve capacity distinct from the employee's delivery, while the filing's unresolved populations remain visible.
Award terms determine vesting, settlement medium, delivery and withholding. The performance section begins only after the document states why plan capacity cannot answer an individual award.

cold_reader_answers.what_tax_effect_enters_eps: The supplied later earnings tax consequence associated with removing interest; the initial equity charge does not enter the EPS numerator.
cold_reader_answers.why_histories_remain_joint: The same annual share average can be generated by different event dates, producing different intermediate states and future consequences.
cold_reader_answers.what_is_missing_for_an_award: The applicable grant, vesting, settlement and performance terms; general plan capacity or proxy arithmetic cannot fill them.

four_ledgers.reader_comprehension: The chapter moves from instrument tax mechanics to dated share histories and then to award-specific contractual terms.
four_ledgers.mathematical_integrity: The displayed tax identities, time-weighting equation and conditional award calculations were followed under their stated synthetic or disclosed inputs.
four_ledgers.source_fidelity: Apple disclosure amounts are treated as constraints and populations, not as complete reconstructed histories; source-version differences remain visible.
four_ledgers.typography: Pages 189–194 were inspected at 110 dpi. Equations, table boundaries and the transition into performance conditions remain legible.

local_inspection_groups.exit_state: The document has separated plan capacity, award terms, share histories and tax consequences. The next pages formalize performance conditions and their settlement consequences under explicitly supplied return and vesting inputs.
